operation.description:
MUTATING operation. Verify target and authorized intent; reconcile outcome before retry. Updates an existing leave application, identified by the `{ID}` path segment. This is a v2 native-entity endpoint served from the `/v2/api/entity` base and authenticated with a Bearer token. The request body is a **flat JSON object** of leave-application fields.

Provide the fields to change. The record is re-validated, so keep the date range and day count consistent: `date_to` must equal `date_from + (days − 1)` and be on or after `date_from`. Conditional requirements follow `type` exactly as on create:

| `type` | Meaning | Additionally required |
|---|---|---|
| `leave` | Leave | `leave_type_id` |
| `half_leave` | Half (½) Leave | `leave_type_id` |
| `delay` | Late Arrival | `late_time` |
| `early` | Early Leave | `early_time` |

Server-managed fields cannot be changed here: `status` (moved by the approval workflow, not this endpoint), `approved_by`, `created_by` and the approval-cycle fields. The `comment` field can only be set when the application is created — it is not editable here (send it on create instead). On success the standard native-entity `{ message, id }` envelope is returned.

> Known issue (dev): the update pipeline currently faults and returns HTTP 500 `{"message":"Server Error"}` for this entity (the target row is left unchanged) — see the audit report. The contract below is the intended one.

parameters.name: ID
parameters.description: The id of the leave application to update.

staff_id.description: Id of the staff member the leave is for.

date_to.description: Last day of leave, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Must be on or after `date_from` and equal to `date_from + (days − 1)`.

type.description:
Kind of application.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| leave | Leave |
| half_leave | Half (½) Leave |
| delay | Late Arrival |
| early | Early Leave |

attachments.description: Optional. Files attached to the application (max 5 MB each). Editable on update.

200.description: The leave application was updated; the standard native-entity `{ message, id }` envelope is returned.

id.description: Id of the updated leave application.

400.description: The update failed. Three shapes: `{ "message": "Record not found" }` when the `{ID}` does not exist; `{ "message": "Entity not saved", "errors": { … } }` when required fields are missing or invalid for the chosen `type` (per-field messages in `errors`); or the `{ e, message, error }` envelope on a database save failure.

message.description: Failure summary. `Record not found` when the `{ID}` does not exist; `Entity not saved` on a validation or save failure.

errors.description: Present on a validation failure: per-field messages keyed by field name (e.g. a missing `staff_id`/`date_from`/`date_to`/`days`).

e.description: Present on a database save failure: error detail object (or empty array).

error.description: Present on a database save failure: failure detail.

401.description: The Bearer token is missing, invalid, or expired.

500.description: Currently returned by the update pipeline for this entity on dev (`{"message":"Server Error"}`); the target row is left unchanged. Recorded as a known issue in the audit report.
